title: Fee Structure
content: The annual tuition fee for engineering programs (B.Tech) at SRM vary by campus and specialization. For the Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) and allied branches, the annual tuition fee is approximately INR 3,00,000 to INR 4,50,000 depending on the specific campus (Kattankulathur is usually higher). Other branches like Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication (ECE), and Mechanical Engineering range from INR 2,00,000 to INR 3,00,000 per year. In addition to the tuition fee, there is a one-time non-refundable registration fee of INR 10,000 and a refundable caution deposit of INR 5,000 payable during first-year admission. Hostel, mess, and transportation fees are charged separately. Exam fees are billed per semester based on the number of credits taken.
